title: Heat Seems to Rise
description: HEAT SEEMS TO RISE from this poster by Japanese artist Noriyoshi Ohrai (front), which has a very realistic C-3PO and R2-D2 against what appears to be a galaxy of super novae. The poster was printed as a limited edition for sale in Japan. Clearly the most unusual of all the foreign posters for RETURN THE JEDl(or in this case, POWROT JEDI), is this exploding Darth Vader head (back), a lithograph from Poland by artist Witold Dybowski.
